reviewer.lens: fresh independent Phase 0 after convergence checkpoint

findings.summary: Post-capture port and artifact accessors lack retained identity validation.
findings.location: trust.py CapturedLifecyclePort.artifact/audit and CapturedJsonArtifact.value/audit, around line 512
findings.counterexample: After bindings.require() consumes a valid stream, a single handle poke replaces port._artifact or artifact._value. Accessors return forged data.
findings.consequence: Unverified data delivery violates ADR-0123 final immutable captured value and ADR-0126 public opaque-handle/single-poke rule. Publication/freeze validators cannot catch this post-capture path.
findings.disposition: Open; successor full-handle convergence checkpoint requested before another matrix correction.

reviewer_conclusion: The retained publication/stream-pin design otherwise closes the post-PUBLISHED descriptor and frozen-identity family stated in 0114.
reviewer_limits: Read-only design review; no new RED, full focused suite, real execution, or environment changes.
next_gate: Independent full-handle convergence checkpoint, family-wide matrix correction, fresh clean Terra Phase 0 before RED.
